goal: Implement the approved Developer AI Code Improvement feature as advisory-only guidance for assigned Python bug reports.
acceptance_criteria: Only an authenticated Developer assigned to the report can request the feature.
The feature sends bounded relevant context through the shared server-only gateway.
Suggestions are categorized, explained, advisory-only, and never executed or persisted as revisions.
Prompt injection, unauthorized access, oversize input, malformed output, provider failure, quota, and no-mutation cases are covered by tests.
Lint, typecheck, unit tests, and build pass; database regression checks are run when supported.
